mapper.sql: id, analysis_id, endpoint, status, summary, steps, error_code, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, source_type, source_url, project_name, title, level, status, progress, is_public, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, overview FROM analyses WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, user_id, source_type, source_url, project_name, title, level, status, progress, is_public, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at, overview FROM analyses WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_flows (analysis_id, endpoint, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{endpoint}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE analysis_flows SET status = 'DONE', summary = #{summary}, steps = #{steps, javaType=[Lcom.vibenote.analysis.flow.FlowStep;, typeHandler=com.vibenote.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
